systems.system: System of the civil and criminal identification posts (unnamed)
systems.country_label: sistema nos postos de identificação civil e criminal
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos; the Direcção Nacional de Identificação, Registos e Notariado (DNIRN) is the central office
systems.tiers: Identification and civil registry posts almost countrywide, the DNIRN centre and SIAC citizen service centres; issues identity cards, criminal record certificates and death certificates. Posts without system for about four months to May 2026, blamed on telecommunications breaks

note: The outage reported is of the justice ministry's identification posts, which issue criminal record certificates: an identification system, not the police's station records, so no fact.
